verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only shows admin/compliance-oriented export APIs and a fixed 21-day recovery window for deleted messages (ms-teams-docs-13, ms-teams-docs-14) — this is not user-facing retention/deletion control, let alone anything specific to AI-native features like Copilot data handling. No documentation describes an AI-native user being able to configure or delete their own AI interaction data or retention settings.
